comparisons.name: label-light
comparisons.description: The first volume icon of the desktop over the picture, Aqua: the label, 12 pt bold white with its shadow, centred under the tile. The tile is masked, because the volume artwork is Apple's; the backdrop is a gradient near the picture. The text is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms, which is why this comparison is loose.

comparisons.name: label-light-masked
comparisons.description: The same crop with the label masked as well, Aqua: what is left is the backdrop, which shows that nothing but the label is drawn outside the tile.

comparisons.name: selected-light
comparisons.description: A selected icon, which no screenshot shows on the desktop, Aqua: the backing behind the tile, 2 pt wider than the tile all round, and the accent behind the name. The values are Finder's icon-view selection as the spec infers it (provisional).

pixels.note: backing in the middle of the tile: black at 20% over the backdrop
the backing reaches 2 pt past the 64 pt tile
the name's highlight, above the letters: selectedContentBackgroundColor
